definition: WellFoundedConcreteAt means Lean's WellFounded holds on the predecessor relation restricted to actually existing concrete individuals, ordered cause-to-dependent. It excludes predecessor cycles and non-well-founded descents, but does not imply a finite past, finite branching, a universal cause, or anything about the soundness of actual metaphysical causation.
note: Analyst-defined #487 conditional semantics, not an established causal or metaphysical premise. Whole histories, rigid cross-world identity, supplied concreteness, and generic causation are independently contestable.
